facts: Run 40 completed the V3 development workflow; no V3 candidate is frozen or production eligible.
The 1w regime-only Elastic Net development signal is the current teacher hypothesis, not confirmatory evidence.
Teacher diagnostic used 46 walk-forward forecasts; the signal beat Persistence on about 56.5% of origins.
Teacher diagnostic mean loss improvement was about +0.455 percentage points and worst leave-one-out mean improvement about +0.334 percentage points.
Stable teacher features include trend_close_vs_sma_13, trend_sma_4_vs_13, trend_close_vs_sma_4, trend_sma_13_vs_26, vol_ratio_13_vs_26, and vol_ratio_4_vs_13.
Corrected statistical diagnostics use a studentized circular moving-block bootstrap with HAC/Bartlett studentization, a minimum of 20 diagnostic origins, and Holm multiplicity control.
Insufficient diagnostic samples are scientific non-results and remain in the Holm family conservatively.
Monthly horizons remain insufficient-history development cases.
Agent proposals are hypotheses only and must pass deterministic implementation, tests, development tournament, nested selection, corrected statistical diagnostics, and leakage/adversarial review.

initial_wave.DEVIL-01: Try to falsify the strongest 1w development signal, focusing on concentration, regime dependence, instability, and alternative explanations.
initial_wave.FEATURE-01: Explain and improve the 1w trend/regime signal without coefficient transfer; propose isolated point-in-time ablations.
initial_wave.LEAKAGE-01: Adversarially audit feature timestamps, labels, nested-selection boundaries, target maturity, and provenance for leakage.
initial_wave.NEURAL-01: Specify exactly one bounded neural time-series challenger with train-fold-only preprocessing and deterministic evaluation; no broad architecture search.
initial_wave.STATS-01: Audit corrected statistical-judge assumptions, dependence handling, multiplicity, and sample adequacy; do not change thresholds to force significance.
